testCase.name: [dev] S05 Hospital day: day source × entry date (decision table), with frozen-counter rows that need no aging helper

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B23 · P1 · 已知

病人卡片缺字段：年龄是「76y」不是「76F」，医院卡片没有住院天数，养老院卡片没有访视次数

票：TFA-92579 AC3–4 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S03, TC-01/S06, TC-01/S26

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S05 「住院天数：天数来源 × 填写日期（决策表），带上不需要 aging helper 的「冻结计数器」行」 Hospital day: day source × entry date (decision table), with frozen-counter rows that need no aging helper

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U6 The day/visit number advances each calendar day by server time and never stays frozen; a device with a wrong clock or time zone shows the same number.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 4；UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given seededCensus H1–H7: admit date only (today, −2 d), admit date with a stale stored Hospital Day, Hospital Day only entered 2 days ago, both set and disagreeing, neither, and manual add vs census scan on the same admission day

When Filter the Hospital list to each patient by full name and snapshot the card

Then Each card shows its own hospital day counted in server calendar days: H3 Day 1, H1 Day 3, H2 Day 6 (stored Day 1 is stale), H4 Day 3 (entered Day 1 two days ago), H7 the same day as H3; H5 and H6 are recorded for Q11/Q2

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Decision table, rows → expected: admit date only → days since admission + 1 (Q2); admit date + stale stored day → by date (H2 Day 6); Hospital Day only → entered day + days since entry (H4 Day 3, Q11); both set and disagreeing → no verdict until Q11 (H5); neither → no junk, display per Q2 (H6); manual vs scan same day → identical (H3 = H7, TC-02). …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U27；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa

医院卡片上都看不到住院天数（'Day 1'、'Day 3'、'Day 6'）。不管是今天添加、几天前入院还是扫描进来的病人都一样，医生看不出病人住了几天。

No Hospital card shows a hospital day ('Day 1', 'Day 3', 'Day 6'), whether the patient was added today, admitted days ago or scanned in, so the physician cannot see how long anyone has been in.

依据：dev U27 (ledger #27). Already in dev report §2 #5 (TFA-92579 AC 3/4; ACs added 10-01 with no PR). H5 (two disagreeing sources) and H6 (no source) were only recorded, for Q11/Q2. The local datasets lane shows the same: no day on any card.

并进来的：本地 datasets TC-01/S05 (same failure, folded into this result)

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S05

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: Fail from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U27.verdict.json), unit U27 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 95 turns, 346 s, $0.81.

Recorded (evidence only):

  • s05-h5-disagree.md: (Q11: day by admit date) fail: no match for /\bDay 5\b/i (in subtree "Open chart for QA U27 QA Hosp Eve Moreau Z6AJ")
  • s05-h5-disagree.md: (Q11: day by the entered Hospital Day) fail: no match for /\bDay 2\b/i (in subtree "Open chart for QA U27 QA Hosp Eve Moreau Z6AJ")
  • s05-h6-neither.md: (Q2: what the card shows with neither an admit date nor a day) fail: no match for /\bDay \d+\b/i (in subtree "Open chart for QA U27 QA Hosp Gus Hale Z6AJ")

Plan: unit U27 (#27, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Card fields and day counts, seeded identities. S03 and S14 have the same seed; S05 seeds the same Ana and Ben Rivera rows plus five more Hospital patients, so one union seed serves all three. Each part isolates its card by searching its name; S05's rounding:list count (7 Hospital rows) is exactly the union's Hospital rows. Runs together with TC-01/S03, TC-01/S14.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #27, U27; checked: yes): Fail (S03, S05 — product, cluster C2) — UAT TC-01 / TFA-92579 AC 3–4: card shows '76y' (no sex, not '76F') and no hospital day / visit number (some show 'New today'); NH card also shows the diagnosis (C1). S14 (chart header, '—' for missing data, nothing invented) passes

  • [dev datasets] 失败（datasets/results.json） — datasets: failed → 失败（失败（lane 没标产品问题）） h3: Day 1 (admit date today, manual add) → no day on the card | h1: Day 3 (admit date 2 d ago) → no day on the card | h2: Day 6 (admit date 5 d ago, stale stored Day 1) → no day on the card | h4: Day 3 (Day 1 entered 2 d ago, no admit date (Q11)) → no day on the card
